name: scdaw_bounce
description: Render project offline into a WAV audio file (16-bit, 24-bit, or 32-bit Float) via OfflineAudioContext, initiating browser download and returning audio metadata.

loops.description: Number of pattern loop repetitions to render (1-8, default 1)

bitDepth.description: Audio bit depth: 16 (CD standard), 24 (studio standard, default), or 32 (32-bit float)

tailSeconds.description: Decay tail duration in seconds for reverb/release (default 0.5)

trimSilence.description: Whether to trim tail silence below -72dBFS threshold (default true)

saveToWorkspace.description: Whether to preserve audio metadata in session storage
